findings.title: [P1] Restore the tenant equality authorization check
findings.body: Returning true unconditionally allows users to read documents belonging to any tenant, creating a cross-tenant data exposure wherever this exported authorization function guards document access.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally. The full diff shows this replaced `userTenant === documentTenant`; the two tenant parameters are now unused, so the participant claim about trusted callers does not restore or independently enforce the exported function's tenant-isolation contract.
